name: The largest that fits: the MORABO U (5-seat corner and chaise) facing the window around the VALNÄS (staged until Andrew's cart, 2026-10-26)
notes:
Alternative since 2026-10-26: the room as staged with the U before Andrew's IKEA cart chose the Sofa with chaise (a).
Staged until 2026-10-26. No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The sofa (F-67, Andrew 2026-10-25: "a chaise, i.e. at least 3 seats", "empty space between like" the MORABO chaise add-on, "the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"): MORABO in Gunnared dark gray on 6 1/4" wood legs, the open base he linked, high enough for a robot vacuum. Its cover is fixed (vacuum and wipe, not washable); the same pieces in Grann/Bomstad leather wipe clean and hold no dust mites (F-66). Every sofa piece is delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22): Andrew can't tape the stairs before the move (2026-10-26, F-07), so the sofa is ordered after move-in day's tape and the beds go first; the largest box is the corner's frame, 78 1/2 x 36 3/4 x 20 1/4".
The largest that fits: IKEA's MORABO 6-seat crn/chaise, a U 141 3/4" across and 95 1/4" deep, built from its two parts in the fabric Andrew linked (the one-piece article comes only in leather, ikea-09575866). It floats with its back on the open side's walkway edge and faces the window: five seats and the chaise (IKEA's "6-seat" counts the chaise) around the VALNÄS, a conversation pit that leaves the play floor on the right 66" wide. Anything bigger would take the play area (F-61) or the route along the window.
chaise-1 MORABO chaise add-on, rot 180, x 36-66.75, y 80.75-143: the U's left end, its lounger toward the window, on the edge of the railing's 36" strip (F-40), its back on the walkway edge (F-42), its foot 74.75" from the heater face (F-33); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
sofa-1 MORABO 5-seat corner, rot 180, x 66.75-177.75, y 47.75-143: the back run (y 106.75-143) faces the window with the 30" walkway behind it (F-39); the 95 1/4" arm on the right (x 141.5-177.75) faces west into the U, its end 41.75" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22). It is sold with the arm on the left seen from the front, so facing the window the arm is on the play side and the chaise by the stairs: the arm's 31 7/8" back is the play floor's edge, and from the back run you see Maddie over it. If IKEA's sofa planner builds the corner the other way round, the arm could go by the stairs instead (not checked). B is the layout where a seat faces the play area.
coffee-table-1 VALNÄS oak ellipse, x 80.875-127.375, y 62.375-90.75: 16" from the back run, 14.125" from the chaise's side and the arm (F-39); no corners at Maddie's head height. The seats along the back run and in the corner are reached through those 14" gaps, as at any coffee table; the narrower LACK (35 3/8") would make them 19.7".
wall-lamp-3 VARPTROSS (top), on the window wall at x 50-57: the group's lamp on the wall, a soft glow (5.9 W), with the ceiling light and the lamp on the VALNÄS for reading; its cord in a cover down the wall to an outlet above the heater, never across it (final audit 2026-10-26: the TÅGARP that stood here, 16.5" off the wall, could reach a window-wall outlet only with its 3' 3" cord lying over the heater, F-33). plant-1 FEJKA bird of paradise at the arm's end, x 168.75-177.75, y 38.5-47.5: the route along the window passes above it, 32.5" from the heater face (F-30). The play corner's UPPLYST, the VARPTROSS over the BESTÅ and wall-lamp-4, a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench as its reading light (final audit 2026-10-26), light the right side.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 36-154, y 29.5-123.5: under the VALNÄS, the whole chaise and the front legs of the back run and the arm (its west edge on the railing strip's edge; until the final audit 2026-10-26 it started at x 45, with the chaise's outer legs 9" off it); two STOPP FILT underlays keep it put. Its page says "Do not wash" and never a rotating brush: the jute can't take the robot vacuum the open base was chosen for (F-67), so give the robot a no-go zone over it, or swap it for a washable flatweave of about 118 x 94" (none in the catalog).
Play area (F-61), as staged before: toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner (x 240.5-261, y 18-53.4) with wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST over it; toy-storage-1 TROFAST below it (x 243.6-261, y 56.4-93), 24" clear in front (F-32), art-1 PJÄTTERYD above; toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ with doors on the right-lower wall (x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142), its FLISAT book display on top and wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS above, art-2 RÖDALM; rug-3 LEN play rug (x 183-235, y 75-138), 5.25" clear of the U's arm; kids-table-1 LÄTT and its two chairs on it (x 188.6-213.4, y 98-116.9), 10.9" east of the arm, a dead gap, and 30.7" on the diagonal from its corner to the TROFAST's corner (243.6, 93), the way from the kitchen side to the play wall (F-30). Until the final audit 2026-10-26 it stood at x 200-224.75, where both ways past it were under 30": 22.25" beside the arm and 19.5" to the TROFAST's corner.
Walkways: the open side's walkway (F-42); the route along the window from the top landing to the play corner, 41.75" at the arm's end and 32.5" past the plant (F-30, F-40); from the kitchen side up to the play wall past the LÄTT, 30.7" between its corner and the TROFAST's (F-30); the bottom landing onto the walkway; the U opens toward the window, so it is entered from there. Nowhere to set a cup from the chaise or the corner seat (the VALNÄS is 29 to 35" from them): a clip-on tray over the chaise's arm would do it without taking floor (not in the catalog).
Not placed: the KIVIK sofa (rejected: no chaise, no open base, F-67); the POÄNG (an armchair would sit in the route along the window); the LACK console and its STORSEGEL (it stood against the old sofa's back, now on the walkway edge) and the side table with its STORSEGEL (no wall beside the U for a lamp's cord); the TÅGARPs (one stood by the window until the final audit 2026-10-26, its cord over the heater; the other, right of the window, in front of the reading bench); the TV and its units (F-65); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21).
Stairs: beyond the left wall behind a railing (F-40), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included; the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the floor along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown.
Heater: clearances run from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces from y 12, upholstery from y 18 (F-33). It runs the whole window wall, so the GINSTMOTT panels must stay off it: hem them to end above it once its height is known, or hang blinds as the office does. Window: eyeballed on the top wall (assumed-position:window); nothing stands under it (F-38).
Power: outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are isn't recorded; the heater runs the whole window wall, so a cord to an outlet there must come down the wall in a cover from a wall lamp, never across the heater from a floor lamp (final audit 2026-10-26: the TÅGARP came off for that reason), and the UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords on the play wall run down it in covers.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass; the FLISAT book display stands on the 15" BESTÅ, 31" together, so fix it to the wall; nothing else is over 27"; the VARPTROSS hangs out of her reach.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1, SVARTPOPPEL covers x3, VALLKRASSING covers x3, FJÄDRAR inserts x6, VALLKRASSING throw x1, LÖVA canopy x1 over the reading bench, STOPP FILT underlays x2 (under the TIOKRONA).
Total $3,950.74: placed $3,658.86 + extras $291.88, prices as of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 (those before today are price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the LÄTT moved 11.4" west, so the way from the kitchen side to the play wall is 30.7" (both ways past it were under 30": 22.25" beside the U's arm and 19.5" to the TROFAST's corner), the LEN with it, and the TIOKRONA 9" west so the whole chaise stands on it; the TÅGARP became a VARPTROSS on the window wall, since its cord would have crossed the heater to reach any outlet there (F-33); a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench is the play wall's reading light.
